opening_message: My 18-month-old has had a fever, been throwing up and had loose poops for the last two days.

disclosure_items.first_person_phrasing: He's had a low fever for about two days.
The throwing up started two days ago too.
The loose poops have been going on those same two days.
We took him to an urgent care clinic last night.
They said to keep giving him acetaminophen and fluids.
He usually pees during the night, but he didn't last night.
I took his temperature under the arm this morning and it was 38.1 degrees Celsius.
He looks unwell, but he's alert and looks me in the eye.
His pulse seems to be about 140.
He's breathing quickly, I counted 32 breaths a minute.
